description: Book a prepared flight only after the traveler explicitly confirms the exact current quote, total, currency, and consent version. Use the handoff_id and quote_id returned by prepare_flight_booking and a saved payment_id from get_payment_methods. Gondola derives the traveler ID and type and a stable booking request ID; do not invent or retry with different identities. If the outcome is uncertain, retrieve the booking state instead of repeating the mutation.

confirm.description: Must be true after the traveler explicitly confirms the exact displayed quote and terms.

consent_version.description: The exact consent version returned with the current quote.

contact.description: Contact details for booking notices and disruption communication.

phone.description: Traveler contact phone with country code.

currency.description: The three-letter currency shown with the confirmed total, such as USD.

expected_total_amount.description: The exact displayed total amount the traveler confirmed.

handoff_id.description: The Gondola handoff ID returned by prepare_flight_booking.

payment_id.description: The saved payment method ID returned by get_payment_methods. Never provide card numbers or security codes.

quote_id.description: The exact current Gondola quote ID returned by prepare_flight_booking.

traveler.description: The adult traveler whose identity will be derived by Gondola for this booking.

born_on.description: Traveler's birth calendar date as YYYY-MM-DD.

gender.description: Traveler gender accepted by the booking supplier.

name: book_flight
